deadline.value: International first-year application deadlines: Early Decision I November 1, Early Action November 15, Early Decision II January 20, and Regular Decision January 15. The ED agreement is a separate supporting document: November 1 for EDI and January 15 for EDII. International financial forms are due by the chosen application deadline.
